race.title: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Apprentice Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: A tricky race to assess so a chance is taken on TAKE THE A TRAIN . His very best efforts to date have come at this course and he ought to be sharper for his mid-field effort over further at Redcar a month ago. Multaneighttothree and Tomorrow Day are 2 of the likeliest dangers. TAKE THE A TRAIN MULTANEIGHTTOTHREE (IRE) TOMORROW DAY
